items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: And they bought all the Bunk records... And Bunny Berrigan playing I Can't Get Started. That's one of the first records I ever, you know.

ctx.x: Did you sort of start getting a taste for it?

Well, the first record I ever heard that I could even class as jazz was Pee Wee Hunt's record, The 12th Street Rag, which came out when I was about 14. And that was the first time I ever noticed jazz, you know. And then I was in school in Ireland, in Belfast, in boarding school, and all we had to do was listen to records. And some fellows got interested in jazz. There's a band in Belfast. They're always, they were a Dixieland band, and they always got very offended when anybody ever mentioned the Dixieland…
